notes_for_editor: Thin record: no page read describes Hotchkiss's construction history, staffing, fires or current condition. The only pre-2012 evidence is the 2009 map label, which appears in the PDF text as spaced letters (H OT C H K I S S). The layer's TOWER_HEIGHT 30.0 has no unit (read as metres, per the brief). The brief's 'closed' access and 'no public access' wording do not appear in any page read, so access is set to restricted. Standing rests on the layer's ACTIVE flag. The name is not tied to the Hotchkiss hamlet in the County of Northern Lights in any source read, and the story does not link them. Canada Lookouts has no Hotchkiss page.
